description: Beaverome (192x192), a bowl of shallow lakes and narrow sloping shores with little flat ground: the start shore holds the pits, the limestone quarry and small workshops, the sandstone quarry lies on the level-13 south shore, two Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites on the level-12 north-west shore, two Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites east and north of the start, the map's two Underground Ruins under 6.2 and 8.6 m of lake water (drain one for the Efficient Mine), the Nuclear Reactor on the level-11 south-west shore on 39 platform blocks beside the Cryogenic Liquefaction Plant, and the five Human Record Caches around one Archive Excavation in the south-east.

playerWork.item: renewable scrap (Underground Ruins for the Efficient Mine)
playerWork.reason: Both Underground Ruins lie on lake beds with no dry cell beside them: (117, 41, 3) under 6.2 of clean water in the 11,197-cell lake fed by sources of strength 33.5, whose shore is beside the start (route 0), and (149, 137, 0) under 8.6 of badwater (3,682-cell lake, shore at route 69). A player drains the lake over one, the shallower first, and builds the Efficient Mine on it (vanilla Beaverome: its builders "drained seven mighty craters"); until then scrap comes from the surface ruins (5,340).
